title: What's New in AL-Go for GitHub: Introducing Custom Templates (2025 release wave 2)

features.name: Custom templates for AL-Go
features.description: Support for creating custom AL-Go templates that act as a middle layer between the original AL-Go template and end repositories, allowing teams to define custom jobs and settings that propagate to repositories using the custom template.
caveats: Native AL-Go workflows cannot be removed or changed apart from adding custom jobs
AL-Go actions used in custom jobs will not be updated automatically
Non-AL-Go files and custom templates are not updated when running update AL-Go system files

features.name: Custom jobs in AL-Go workflows
features.description: Ability to add custom jobs to existing AL-Go workflows by injecting YAML code directly into workflows provided by AL-Go. Custom jobs must be prefixed with 'custom job' to avoid conflicts.
caveats: Custom jobs must be prefixed with 'custom job' to avoid conflicts with future native jobs
AL-Go actions in custom jobs will not be automatically updated
Custom jobs are limited to specific scenarios for consuming output of native jobs

features.name: Settings propagation in custom templates
features.description: Custom settings defined in custom AL-Go templates are propagated to end repositories that reference those custom templates through a new settings file.
caveats: Settings are propagated only to repositories referencing the custom template

features.name: Native job dependencies with custom jobs
features.description: Native AL-Go jobs can depend on custom jobs and vice versa, and the output of native jobs can be consumed in custom jobs for integration between native and custom workflow components.
caveats: Output consumption by custom jobs is limited to one specific scenario in the build process
